scope: Primary-source shortlist, not an exhaustive inventory of all cybersecurity datasets

datasets.name: cAPTure
datasets.capture_note: Shifted semi-synthetic packet timelines; seven repeated scenario templates
datasets.status: two reduced CSVs acquired; consistency checks passed; no model fit
datasets.limits: Reduced-generation provenance and causal feature availability need further qualification

datasets.name: CAM-LDS
datasets.limits: Seven scenario families,34 variants; no simulated benign user activity

datasets.name: Windows-APT2025
datasets.status: paper and public artifact route verified; file bytes not acquired
datasets.limits: 36 emulated scenarios; verify benign labels and scenario joins; named emulated profiles do not establish actor attribution

datasets.name: CICAPT-IIoT2024
datasets.status: paper/public page verified; current access requires contact form
datasets.limits: APT29-inspired emulation; actual bytes and independent-run structure not yet verified

datasets.name: DEDALE
datasets.limits: Four weeks, one APT exercise; whole raw collection about3.2TB, smaller log views available

datasets.name: CasinoLimit
datasets.status: annotation archive and milestone manifest inspected; full event adapter pending
datasets.limits: 114 labeled instances of one challenge, some repeat players, no realistic ordinary-user benign background

datasets.name: Comprehensive Advanced Persistent Threats Dataset
datasets.status: 24-archive inventory and one small campaign file inspected
datasets.limits: Rule-derived labels and artificial stage markers in commands; independent benign truth unverified

datasets.name: AIT-LDSv2.1
datasets.status: 80 source/label/metadata members acquired across8runs; first CPU pilot
datasets.limits: Selected intranet annotation pairs are attack-rich and dominated by directory scans; repeated templates; incomplete lifecycle coverage

datasets.name: AIT-ADS
datasets.status: 96MB archive acquired; exact alert-label joining pending
datasets.role: alternative alert view of AIT-LDS, not independent second data
datasets.limits: Attack-interval labels alone cannot identify individual malicious alerts

datasets.name: Linux-APT2024
datasets.limits: Suspicious labels are based on Wazuh TTP tags; measures rule imitation without independent incident labels

datasets.name: Corrected DARPA OpTC
datasets.limits: About939GB compressed; new corrections do not make the attack capture new
